# DMR short message reference vectors
#
# Burst bits generated by the host prototype of work/dmr-sms, the
# implementation validated against ETSI TS 102 361-1/-3 and the seven
# payload flavours seen on the air:
#
#   work/dmr-sms/build/dmr_sms gen --fmt <fmt> --text <text> --src <src>
#       --dst <dst> [--group] [--confirmed] [--seq <seq>] --cc 1 \
#       --bits out.bits --out /dev/null
#
# One CASE line per message, then one BURST line per slot: 36 octets,
# the 288 bits of the slot (CACH, burst, sync).  tests/platform/c62_sms_host.c
# compares them with what the firmware transmit chain renders.
